sources.title: S.O. 5322(E) — Commencement of Code on Wages, 2019
sources.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.notes: Appoints 21 November 2025 as commencement date for sections 1-41; 42(4)-(9); 43-66; 67(1), 67(2)(a-r)(u-zc), 67(3)-(5); 68; 69 except items already in force via S.O. 4604(E) dated 18 Dec 2020. Gazette No. 5146, CG-DL-E-21112025-267885.

sources.title: S.O. 5319(E) — Commencement of Code on Social Security, 2020
sources.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.notes: Appoints 21 Nov 2025 for ss.1-14; 15(1)(2); 16(1)(c); 17-141; 143 except S.O.2060(E) 3 May 2023 items; 144-163; items 1,2,4-9 of s.164(1); 164(2)(a)(c) and 164(3). ITEM 3 OF s.164(1) (EPF Act 1952 repeal) NOT commenced.

sources.title: S.O. 5320(E) — Commencement of Industrial Relations Code, 2020
sources.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.notes: Appoints 21 November 2025 as the date on which the provisions of the IR Code shall come into force (entire Code). F.No. S-11025/07/2025-IR(PL). Gazette CG-DL-E-21112025-267883.

sources.title: Code on Wages (Central) Rules, 2026 — G.S.R. 343(E)
sources.notes: Notified 8 May 2026 after draft G.S.R. 936(E) dated 30 Dec 2025. Supersedes Payment of Wages (Procedure) Rules 1937, Minimum Wages (Central) Rules 1950 and multiple other wage-related Central rules. Applies where Central Government is appropriate Government.

sources.notes: Helpline 14434. For grievances relating to e-Shram services (MoLE, CSC). NOT a wage-claim forum.

sources.title: SAMADHAN Portal
sources.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment / Chief Labour Commissioner (Central)
sources.notes: Worker-facing industrial dispute and wage-claim portal. Homepage still lists Industrial Disputes Act 1947, Payment of Wages Act 1936, Minimum Wages Act 1948 etc. PIB Year End Review 2025 says portal is under revamp for Codes. CONFLICT: portal content vs Code commencement. Email samadhan-mole[at]gov[dot]in; phone 011-23473215.

sources.title: SAMADHAN Portal FAQ
sources.notes: FAQ still maps claims to Payment of Wages Act 1936, Minimum Wages Act 1948, Industrial Disputes Act 1947. Requires human review for post-21-Nov-2025 mapping to Codes.

sources.title: Shram Suvidha Portal 2.0
sources.notes: EMPLOYER compliance portal (LIN, registration, licence, inspection, returns). NOT a worker grievance portal. Helpdesk 011-23473215, 011-23766935, 011-23313358; help-shramsuvidha[at]gov[dot]in. Aligned with Codes per about-us page.

sources.title: Shram Suvidha Registration
sources.notes: Employer registration under EPFO/ESIC/CLRA/BOCW/ISMW historically. Post-Code alignment claimed on Shram Suvidha 2.0 about page.

sources.title: PIB document: Formalising and Safeguarding India’s Gig & Platform Workforce
sources.authority: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Labour and Employment
sources.notes: Dated 9 Dec 2025. Official definitions of aggregator, gig worker, platform worker, platform work. Aggregator contribution 1-2% of annual turnover capped at 5% of amounts paid/payable. Does NOT create a deactivation reinstatement right.
